title: 23-BCV-004 — Sprinkler-protected glazing in fire-resistant wall assemblies

facts.text: The variance addresses interior or exterior fire-rated assemblies otherwise subject to CAN/ULC-S101 testing under Sentences 3.1.7.1.(1) and 9.10.3.1.(1).
The assembly must be evaluated by an SCC-accredited testing agency to CAN/ULC-S136:2021, and its sprinkler system must conform to NFPA 13 with listed specific-application window sprinklers.

The published conditions include fixed glazing, two-sided sprinkler protection where required, rating no less than the wall rating, limits on use in firewalls/high-hazard/explosion locations and specified exits, and fire-alarm requirements.
facts.locator: PDF pp.2–3, Variance conditions 4–11 and final paragraph

facts.text: The document states that sprinkler-protected glazing may be used in sprinklered or unsprinklered buildings, subject to its conditions.
